This project is a Flask-based Book Catalogue web application. Please follow best practices for Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, and Jinja2 templates. Organize code into models, API routes (Blueprints), and frontend views. Use RESTful conventions for API endpoints. The Book model includes: id, title, author, isbn (unique, optional), publication_year (optional), genre (optional).
